title: Promotion Code Settings for Online Orders Delivery Services
content:
Promotion codes on Online Orders run on the same settings whichever delivery service the order uses.

| Delivery service | Promotion codes per order, at most | Late-code window (calendar days after the placed date) | Codes on pre-order and back-order reservations | Codes on gift card lines |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Economy Ground | 1 | 7 | Excluded | Excluded |
| Pickup Point Delivery | 1 | 7 | Excluded | Excluded |
| Standard Ground | 1 | 7 | Excluded | Excluded |
| Expedited 2-Day | 1 | 7 | Excluded | Excluded |
| Next Business Day | 1 | 7 | Excluded | Excluded |
| Same-Day Courier | 1 | 7 | Excluded | Excluded |

| Delivery service | Spreading an order-level discount over lines | Rounding of allocated discounts |
|---|---|---|
| Economy Ground | Pro rata by eligible line price | Per line, half up to the cent; remainder to the highest-priced line |
| Pickup Point Delivery | Pro rata by eligible line price | Per line, half up to the cent; remainder to the highest-priced line |
| Standard Ground | Pro rata by eligible line price | Per line, half up to the cent; remainder to the highest-priced line |
| Expedited 2-Day | Pro rata by eligible line price | Per line, half up to the cent; remainder to the highest-priced line |
| Next Business Day | Pro rata by eligible line price | Per line, half up to the cent; remainder to the highest-priced line |
| Same-Day Courier | Pro rata by eligible line price | Per line, half up to the cent; remainder to the highest-priced line |

## Setting definitions

- **Promotion codes per order**: the most promotion codes one order can carry.
- **Late-code window**: the calendar days after the placed date within which a valid code that was not entered at checkout can be applied.
- **Codes on reservations** and **codes on gift card lines**: "Excluded" means promotion codes do not apply to pre-order and back-order reservations, or to gift card lines.
- **Spreading**: an order-level discount is spread over the lines in proportion to each eligible line's price.
- **Rounding**: each line's share of the discount is rounded half up to the cent, and the cent remainder left between the rounded shares and the discount goes to the highest-priced line.
